slides.name: Data center spending
slides.line: Bank of America forecast, reported by Reuters
slides.catch: Most of the money goes to servers, and most of the trade work is construction that ends when the build wraps.

slides.name: Audi picks Georgia
slides.line: First US plant, in Peach County. Reported by WGXA.
slides.catch: Site grading in 2027, construction in 2028, full production in 2031.

slides.name: Hyundai Translead
slides.line: Will County, Illinois. Reported by FreightWaves.
slides.catch: Builders first, then maintenance techs, industrial electricians and millwrights.

slides.name: Carrier in Fort Worth
slides.catch: Blue Bird: about $300 million and 375 jobs in Fort Valley, Georgia.

slides.name: US-Denmark shipbuilding deal
slides.catch: It covers shipyard training and ship repair, but names no shipyards or job counts yet. Watch for real projects before you move.
